classification: local historical replay of bundled LEAN sample data through Lumibot 4.6.1 (GPL-3.0, evaluation only), scored by the unchanged spy-parity compare.py; not an unchanged upstream test, a point-in-time dataset, a strategy result or any broker execution

result.prediction: BLOCKED, 28 of 29, only native_end_cash failing and attributed to distributions_and_cash (preregistration.json predictions.lumibot)
prediction_falsifiers_observed: Both fills stamped at their decision bar's end instant (1577826000 and 1588190400), not at the next session's first bar end (1577977200 and 1588255200).
Both fills priced at their decision bar's open (320.9400 and 293.9900), not at the next session's first bar open (323.58 and 291.69).
Five failures besides native_end_cash (the four fill checks and the reconciled end cash), none attributable.
Failed guards in both runs: causality, fill_at_next_session_first_bar and submission_clock.
result.mechanism: The pre-run finding recorded before the attempt: the backtesting broker processes pending orders at the current clock whenever the strategy next awaits the market open, before the clock advances, and prices a market order at the open of the bar indexed at that clock. With END-indexed bars, a GTC market order submitted in after_market_closes at 16:00 fills at 16:00 at the open of the bar that has just completed. The fills use prices printed one hour before each decision, which is why the reconciled end cash is 1501.76 above the oracle (304 x 2.64 on entry plus 304 x 2.30 on exit); native cash also lacks the 428.64 of unposted distributions.
result.scope: One historical-simulation case (one_zero) on bundled sample data. It ranks, promotes or adopts no engine and says nothing about one_stress, two_zero, later cases, paper or live operation.

post_hoc_results.reading: Deciding at the next session's open instant (10:00) and submitting there reproduces the oracle's fill instants, prices and reconciled end cash exactly, leaving only the unposted distributions: the preregistered BLOCKED shape. It is not a pass of the preregistered strategy: the order is submitted at the instant it fills and is priced at the 09:30 open of the bar that just completed, which the port contract excludes (engine clock at submission before the fill; guard submission_clock failed in both runs).

Deciding before the next open (09:00) fills the entry at the next session's first bar open only because the 2019-12-31 to 2020-01-02 gap exceeds the broker's one-day fill-distance guard, which defers the order to 10:00; the exit (2020-04-29 to 04-30, an 18-hour gap) fills at 09:00 at the decision bar's open.

port.decision_hook: after_market_closes (the preregistration's example hook), chosen before the first attempt: at the session-final bar's end (16:00 New York; 13:00 on 2019-12-24) it reads that bar with get_historical_prices(asset, 1, 'hour', timeshift=-1), checks its end instant and close against the converted row, sizes with fixture_strategy.target_quantity over the engine-reported portfolio value and submits one market order with time_in_force gtc. --decision-hook before_market_opens or before_starting_trading exists for post-hoc variants only.
port.why_this_hook: The probes showed no hook inside the port contract's window (submission at or after the decision bar's end and before the fill) that lands the fill on the next session's first bar: only before_starting_trading does, and it submits at the fill instant. after_market_closes is the preregistration's example and submits at LEAN's own decision instant; before_market_opens would have been chosen for a calendar artifact (the one-day fill-distance guard that happens to rescue the 2019-12-31 entry), not for a mechanism.
